"""Supplemental real-media/raw-adapter CLI checks after public model release."""
import os
os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = ""
os.environ["OMP_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"
os.environ["MKL_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"
import hashlib
import json
import platform
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path('/workspace/tiny-perceptron-vlm')
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
from scripts.check_course_models import run_command, save_evidence, validate_folder
import torch
torch.set_num_threads(1)
torch.manual_seed(0)

def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

manifest_path = ROOT / 'docs/course-experiments/public-models.json'
models = {x['id']: x for x in json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())['models']}
for ident in ('style', 'lora', 'ocr', 'real_modal'):
    validate_folder(models[ident], ROOT / 'checkpoints/course' / ident)

image = ROOT / 'outputs/course-student/ocr-42.png'
image.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
import PIL
import numpy
import soundfile
from scripts.prepare_ocr import draw_digits
draw_digits('42').save(image)
media = ROOT / 'outputs/course-student/real-modal'
fashion = media / 'vision-initial/images/fashion-train-00044-label-9.png'
recording = media / 'fsdd-initial/recordings/0_theo_5.wav'
assert fashion.is_file() and recording.is_file(), 'Run the model-card asset fetch command first'
formal_path = ROOT / 'docs/course-experiments/results/real_modal.json'
formal = json.loads(formal_path.read_text())['results']
fashion_row = next(row for row in formal['fashion-mnist']['data']['splits']['test']['records'] if row['family'] == fashion.name)
audio_row = next(row for row in formal['fsdd']['data']['splits']['test']['records'] if row['family'] == recording.name)
assert digest(fashion) == fashion_row['image_sha256']
assert Path(audio_row['audio']).name == recording.name
commands = [
    ('ocr-fixed-font', [sys.executable, 'scripts/infer_modal.py', 'checkpoints/course/ocr/model.pt', '--image', str(image), '--prompt', 'read digits', '--tokens', '5', '--device', 'cpu']),
    ('fashion-heldout-image', [sys.executable, 'scripts/infer_modal.py', 'checkpoints/course/real_modal/fashion-mnist.pt', '--image', str(fashion), '--prompt', 'clothing?', '--tokens', '32', '--device', 'cpu']),
    ('fsdd-heldout-recording', [sys.executable, 'scripts/infer_modal.py', 'checkpoints/course/real_modal/fsdd.pt', '--audio', str(recording), '--resample-audio', '--prompt', 'digit?', '--tokens', '32', '--device', 'cpu']),
]
for style in ('concise', 'vivid'):
    commands.append(('raw-lora-' + style, [sys.executable, 'scripts/infer.py', 'checkpoints/course/style/content.pt', '--adapter', 'checkpoints/course/lora/adapter-' + style + '.pt', '--chat', '--prompt', '2+2=?', '--tokens', '96', '--device', 'cpu', '--json']))

proof = {
    'schema_version': 1,
    'checked_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'scope': 'Five individual CLI operation checks with generated digits, original held-out media and bound raw LoRA adapters. Sample answers are not a new accuracy evaluation.',
    'code_checkout_revision': subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip(),
    'manifest_sha256': digest(manifest_path),
    'public_sources': {k: {'repo': models[k]['repo'], 'revision': models[k]['revision']} for k in ('style', 'lora', 'ocr', 'real_modal')},
    'environment': {'python': platform.python_version(), 'torch': str(torch.__version__), 'device': 'cpu', 'threads': 1, 'numpy': numpy.__version__, 'pillow': PIL.__version__, 'soundfile': soundfile.__version__},
    'verification_program': Path(__file__).read_text(),
    'source_sha256': {k: digest(ROOT / k) for k in ('scripts/infer.py', 'scripts/infer_modal.py', 'scripts/prepare_ocr.py', 'scripts/fetch_training_assets.py', 'tiny_perceptron/adapters.py', 'tiny_perceptron/multimodal.py', 'tiny_perceptron/tokenization.py')},
    'input_selection_evidence': {'formal_report': str(formal_path.relative_to(ROOT)), 'formal_report_sha256': digest(formal_path), 'fashion_custom_test_record': fashion_row, 'audio_custom_test_record': audio_row, 'audio_scope': 'CLI starts from the original 8 kHz PCM16 recording and uses the declared resampling flag; the formal test record points to a derived 16 kHz FLOAT WAV, so its file hash is different.'},
    'input_sha256': {str(p.relative_to(ROOT)): digest(p) for p in (image, fashion, recording)},
    'checkpoint_sha256': {},
    'commands': [],
    'preparation': ["python scripts/fetch_training_assets.py --asset fashion-mnist --asset fsdd --output outputs/course-student/real-modal", "from scripts.prepare_ocr import draw_digits; draw_digits('42').save('outputs/course-student/ocr-42.png')"],
}
for name, command in commands:
    print('Checking', name, flush=True)
    record = run_command(command)
    record['example'] = name
    if record['status'] == 'passed':
        result = record['output']
        if not all(k in result for k in ('answer', 'generated_ids', 'eos', 'invalid_special_tokens', 'valid_answer_tokens')):
            record.update(status='failed', reason='Missing explicit generation report fields')
        elif result['invalid_special_tokens'] or not result['valid_answer_tokens']:
            record.update(status='failed', reason='Generated invalid structural token')
    proof['commands'].append(record)
    for p in (command[2], command[command.index('--adapter') + 1] if '--adapter' in command else None):
        if p:
            proof['checkpoint_sha256'][p] = digest(ROOT / p)
proof['status'] = 'passed' if all(x['status'] == 'passed' for x in proof['commands']) else 'failed'
target = save_evidence(ROOT / 'docs/course-experiments/student-checks', 'media-and-raw-adapter-cli', proof)
print(json.dumps({'status': proof['status'], 'evidence': str(target), 'outputs': {x['example']: x.get('output', {}) for x in proof['commands']}}, ensure_ascii=False))
raise SystemExit(0 if proof['status'] == 'passed' else 1)
